steps.label: setup
steps.run:
O="$AGENT_HOME/work/bili3.log"; : > "$O"; exec >>"$O" 2>&1
L='export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"'; RC="$HOME/.bash_profile"
echo "== PATH-Zeile"; if grep -qF "$L" "$RC" 2>/dev/null; then echo "RC_HAS_LINE"; else echo "$L" >> "$RC" && echo "RC_ADDED $RC" || echo "RC_WRITE_FAILED"; fi
echo "== 1 node"; node -v
echo "== 2 claude"; /bin/bash -lc 'command -v claude; claude --version' || { echo STOP_NOCLAUDE; exit 0; }
echo "== 3 install"; npm install -g billion-context --prefix=~/.local || { echo INSTALL_FAILED; exit 0; }
echo "== 4 bili"; /bin/bash -lc 'command -v bili' || echo BILI_NOT_IN_LOGIN_PATH
echo "== 5 version"; /bin/bash -lc 'bili --version' || ~/.local/bin/bili --version
echo DONE3
